verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Approved. The new 135-minute M3 floor is independently pinned above the measured 91.5-minute maximum and below the former unreachable six-hour threshold, while the production behavior is exercised immediately below and above the boundary and on the real worker lane/event key. The policy parser is line-anchored, selects the maximum configured timeout, and fails closed when no assignment exists. The real-file seam binds the shipped constant to policy/repos.toml, and the workflow adds that policy file to the sparse checkout; existing exact-line sparse-checkout assertions cover the live YAML seam. The tests use independent literals and tracking inputs, so the key derivation and reachability claims are non-vacuous. No trust check, permission boundary, token handling, or action pin is weakened.
